vocabulary.meaning_en: fixed money you get for your job, usually every month
vocabulary.example: Her salary is paid at the end of each month.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money paid for each hour, day or week you work
vocabulary.note_ar: hourly wage = أجر بالساعة، weekly wage = أجر أسبوعي
vocabulary.example: Factory workers often get an hourly wage.

vocabulary.meaning_en: all the money you receive from every source
vocabulary.example: Her income comes from her job and from renting a flat.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the payment or paper that shows your salary
vocabulary.note_ar: paycheck أمريكي وتُكتب كلمة واحدة، payslip بريطاني
vocabulary.example: Check your payslip to see the deductions.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an increase in your salary
vocabulary.note_ar: raise أمريكي، pay rise بريطاني؛ من الفعل raise = يرفع
vocabulary.example: I asked my manager for a raise.

vocabulary.meaning_en: extra money given as a reward
vocabulary.example: Everyone got a bonus at the end of the year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: extra hours you work after your normal time
vocabulary.example: I worked three hours of overtime yesterday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: extra things a company gives workers besides pay
vocabulary.example: The job has good benefits, like health insurance.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an agreement that pays you money if you are ill, hurt or lose something
vocabulary.example: The company gives us health and life insurance.

vocabulary.meaning_en: medical services that keep people healthy
vocabulary.note_ar: تُكتب كلمة واحدة أو كلمتين health care
vocabulary.example: Free healthcare is one of the benefits.

vocabulary.meaning_en: what an insurance plan pays for
vocabulary.example: Our insurance coverage includes eye tests.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the time when you stop working because of your age
vocabulary.note_ar: early retirement = تقاعد مبكر؛ retire = يتقاعد
vocabulary.example: He plans to travel after his retirement.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money paid regularly to a person after they retire
vocabulary.example: My grandfather lives on his pension.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an official day when schools and offices are closed
vocabulary.note_ar: في بريطانيا holiday تعني أيضاً الإجازة الشخصية
vocabulary.example: The office is closed for the national holiday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: time you choose to take off work to rest or travel
vocabulary.example: I'm taking a two-week vacation in August.

vocabulary.meaning_en: time off work when you are ill
vocabulary.note_ar: leave هنا اسم = إذن رسمي بالغياب، وليس الفعل «يغادر»
vocabulary.example: She's on sick leave this week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: paid time off for a mother before and after a baby is born
vocabulary.example: She will return after six months of maternity leave.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money people must pay to the government
vocabulary.example: Taxes pay for schools and hospitals.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an amount taken away from your total pay
vocabulary.example: After deductions, my salary is lower.

vocabulary.meaning_en: extra money given for a special purpose
vocabulary.note_ar: housing allowance = بدل سكن، transport allowance = بدل مواصلات
vocabulary.example: The company pays a monthly housing allowance.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a plan of how to spend money
vocabulary.example: We need to stay within our budget.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money you keep and don't spend
vocabulary.example: I used my savings to buy a car.

vocabulary.meaning_en: treating everyone equally and rightly
vocabulary.example: Workers want a fair salary.

vocabulary.meaning_en: giving more than is usual or expected
vocabulary.example: The company offered a generous bonus.

vocabulary.meaning_en: happening at fixed times
vocabulary.example: You will get regular payments every month.

vocabulary.meaning_en: happening once a month
vocabulary.example: We have a monthly team meeting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: happening once a year
vocabulary.example: Your annual leave is 21 days.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to pay someone for work, loss or effort
vocabulary.example: Staff will be compensated for overtime.

vocabulary.meaning_en: having the right to have or do something
vocabulary.example: Employees are entitled to 30 days of leave.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the department that deals with staff, contracts and pay
vocabulary.example: For questions about your contract, contact HR.

vocabulary.meaning_en: all the people who work for a company
vocabulary.example: All staff must attend the meeting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: about; on the subject of
vocabulary.example: I'm writing regarding my salary.

fine_lines.title: salary vs wage
fine_lines.explanation_ar: salary راتب ثابت شهري لا يتغيّر بعدد الساعات، وغالباً لموظفي المكاتب. wage أجر يُحسب حسب عدد الساعات أو الأيام التي عملتها، ويُدفع يومياً أو أسبوعياً، وغالباً لعمال المصانع والبناء والحرفيين.

examples.sentence: She earns a good monthly salary as an accountant.
He gets an hourly wage of fifteen dollars.

fine_lines.title: holiday vs vacation
fine_lines.explanation_ar: holiday عطلة رسمية عامة تُغلق فيها المدارس والشركات مثل العيد. vacation وقتك الشخصي الذي تأخذه من العمل حسب رغبتك للسفر أو الراحة. (في بريطانيا تُستخدم holiday للمعنيين.)

examples.sentence: New Year's Day is a public holiday.
We're going to the beach for our summer vacation.

fine_lines.title: retirement vs pension
fine_lines.explanation_ar: retirement هي المرحلة أو الحالة: توقّفك عن العمل عند سن التقاعد. pension هو المال نفسه: الدفعة الشهرية التي تصلك بعد التقاعد لتصرف منها. تذكّر: تدخل مرحلة retirement، و pension هو ما يغطّي مصاريفك.

examples.sentence: My father is enjoying his retirement.
Her pension is paid on the first day of every month.

fine_lines.title: income vs salary
fine_lines.explanation_ar: salary المال الذي تأخذه من وظيفتك فقط. income كل المال الذي يدخل جيبك من كل المصادر: الوظيفة والاستثمار والتجارة والإيجار. الراتب جزء من الدخل.

examples.sentence: Renting out the shop adds to his income.
My salary went up by ten percent.

expressions.example: The company will foot the bill for the hotel.
Salaries are paid on a monthly basis.
After two great years, she asked for a raise.
You are entitled to sick leave.
We worked overtime to finish the order.
We offer healthcare as well as a pension plan.

grammar.title: Present simple for timetables and schedules
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط للحديث عن المستقبل عندما يكون الحدث مقرراً في جدول رسمي ثابت (مواعيد القطارات والطيران والرواتب ودوام الشركة)، لأن المتحدث يراه حقيقة ثابتة مثل شروق الشمس. أما الخطط الشخصية القابلة للتغيير فنستخدم معها will أو going to.
examples: Our salaries come out on the last Friday of the month.

grammar.title: will / going to for personal plans
grammar.explanation_ar: القرارات والنوايا الشخصية التي يمكن أن تتغير أو تتأجل نستخدم معها will أو be going to، وليس المضارع البسيط.
examples: I'm going to buy a car next year.
Maybe I'll ask for a raise.

questions.question: A factory worker who is paid for every hour gets a:
questions.explanation_ar: wage أجر يُحسب بالساعة أو اليوم.

questions.question: Money you receive every month after you stop working is a:
Choose the best sentence about an official timetable:
choices: The train will maybe leave at 6.
The train is leaving maybe at 6.
The train going to leave at 6.

questions.question: "The company will foot the bill" means the company will:
questions.explanation_ar: foot the bill = يتحمّل التكلفة كاملة.

questions.question: Extra money given for housing or transport is an:
A public day when offices and schools are closed is a:
"Leave" in "sick leave" means:
choices: a green part of a tree
official permission to be away from work
questions.explanation_ar: leave هنا اسم = إذن رسمي بالغياب.

questions.question: Money taken away from your total salary, like tax, is a:
All the money you get from your job, investments and rent is your:
